fieldNotes.truckGate: Trucker reviews of RDC 5084 explicitly describe a gated check-in with 10-20 min in-gate processing and 10-12 trucks queued at the entrance; the private campus ring road is the controlled truck approach to the building.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Trucker reviews explicitly reference a 'guard shack' staffed by check-in personnel at this RDC. Booth not directly visible in public Street View (gate is internal to the private Gateway-park campus), but operational evidence is strong.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock RDC with continuous dock doors on BOTH long faces of the building (east and west) — inbound and outbound run from physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large marked trailer drop yard at the north end plus a second full row of parked trailers along the east apron — well over 50 trailers visible.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Trucker reviews note 10-12 trucks queued to in-gate; ample ring-road approach holds a deep queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide ring-road apron and unused paved width at the campus entrance leave room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated from approach width; gate booth not directly imaged.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~820m x ~360m developed footprint within the Gateway business park).
